title: Rule Absence Semantics: Absence != Verified None
principle: Never treat a missing extracted rule as proof that no such rule exists in the official notification.

RULE_PRESENT_VERIFIED.definition: An explicit rule clause was extracted and verified from authoritative notification text.
RULE_PRESENT_VERIFIED.legalEffect: Rule is active and applied directly.

RULE_ABSENCE_VERIFIED.definition: Exhaustive official audit or explicit negative notification clause confirms no such rule exists (e.g. "No age relaxation is permissible under any circumstances").
RULE_ABSENCE_VERIFIED.legalEffect: Rule is confirmed absent; base rule operates without exception.

RULE_UNRESOLVED.definition: The rule clause has not been audited or extracted from official gazetted sources.
RULE_UNRESOLVED.legalEffect: Rule truth is uncertain; cannot assume rule is absent. Disqualification or false eligibility based on assumption is strictly barred.
